messages:
amy: Customer P-239 reporting a sudden throughput drop on dedicated pool zk-58 since ~02:00 UTC. They see tokens/s down ~60%, API 503s and client timeouts. Customer-facing request id: req_7f3a (redacted link). Pls escalate.
raj: Which model + pool config? continuous batching enabled? any recent deploys? :eyes:
kyle: I'm available to triage. Can you paste the error lines / sample logs?
amy: Model: opt-30b-quant. Pool: zk-58 (dedicated). Config we have: continuous_batching: true, max_batch_tokens: 1024, merge_window_ms: 8, merge_threshold: 0.6. Customer says they didn't change config. Error snippets from their agent: 
```
batcher: emit empty batch after timeout (enqueue timeout)
rpc: client deadline exceeded
serve: handler returning 503
```
They also sent a short flamegraph showing lots of small batches.
kyle: Does this line up with any autoscaler activity?
infra-bot: ALERT pool/zk-58 pending_queue_length spike -> 2026-03-16T01:58:44Z. Autoscaler: scaled_down nodes from 3->1 at 2026-03-16T02:01:03Z (policy: aggressive_scale_down).
raj: Hypothesis: autoscaler scaled down during a short spike of small requests. With merge_window_ms=8 and low node count, continuous batching is producing many tiny batches (overhead dominates) -> tokens/s collapse. Also merge_threshold=0.6 might be rejecting coalescing for mixed sizes.
amy: Customer says traffic pattern was a burst of many short requests (50-200 tokens) from their mobile clients. They saw latency climb first, then 503s.
kyle: Quick repro I ran from prod-like traffic:
```
# stress script (toy)
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":60}' &
  sleep 0.01
done
# watch queue: redwoodctl pool tail zk-58
```
Observed average batch size drop to ~1.4 and tokens/s drop by 55% within 3m.
raj: Immediate mitigation options: increase merge_window_ms to 20ms, lower merge_threshold to 0.4, or enable small_batch_coalesce=true. Also bump min_replicas for zk-58 to prevent scale-to-1 during bursts. Longer term: add autoscale-guard to avoid scale-down when pending_queue_rate > X.
sarah: Reached out to customer with proposed temporary increase to pool min_nodes for 1 hour + config tweak. Customer already gave verbal OK for a short window.
kyle: Applying hotfix: set zk-58.min_replicas=2, merge_window_ms=20, small_batch_coalesce=true. Will monitor.
infra-bot: CONFIG_CHANGE applied by kyle on zk-58 at 2026-03-16T02:05:12Z.
amy: :thumbsup: Customer reports throughput climbing back and error rate falling. They saw baseline throughput ~6m tokens/min restored after ~7m.
raj: Follow-ups: 1) add alert when avg_batch_size < 2.5 for 3m; 2) add autoscale guard (pending_queue_rate threshold) to prevent scale-to-1 during short bursts; 3) schedule a 1-hr tuning session to revisit merge defaults for dedicated pools serving many short requests.
sarah: Customer satisfied for now. I'll keep them updated and close when we have a postmortem.
raj: I'll file a short postmortem and include the reproduce script, graphs, and the hotfix diff.
kyle: Note to oncall: watch zk-58 for 24h for oscillation after config change.
amy: Thanks team. :heart:
